findings: 2026-11-06: drafted for Mathematics 12 Unit 8 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.

Book correction: The book writes |f(c)| < 0.005 \approx 0.01 and |f(c)| < 0.0005 \approx 0.001. The tolerance is the first number: 0.005 for 2 decimal places and 0.0005 for 3 decimal places. 0.01 is twice 0.005, so "\approx 0.01" must not be used as the stopping value. (Examples 3 and 4 stop at 0.0072 and 0.0068, which are not below 0.005; see the corrections there. Their final root 2.61 is still right.)
